ios.desc:
Scrap is the free, simple notepad designed for people who just want to write things down — no sign-ups, no clutter, no learning curve.

CAPTURE IDEAS INSTANTLY
Open the app and start typing. Scrap loads in under a second, so your thoughts never slip away. Perfect for quick notes, to-do lists, meeting notes, and everyday reminders.

STAY ORGANIZED, EFFORTLESSLY
Use tags and colors to sort your notes your way. Search across everything in an instant. Whether you have 10 notes or 10,000, finding what you need is fast and easy.

SYNC ACROSS ALL YOUR DEVICES
Your notes stay with you. iCloud sync keeps everything up to date across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch — automatically.

DESIGNED FOR SIMPLICITY
No bloated features. No subscription walls. Just a clean, distraction-free text editor that helps you focus on what matters. Scrap is lightweight, fast, and built for clarity.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE SCRAP
• Completely free — no ads, no paywalls
• Lightning-fast launch and search
• Simple tags and color-coded organization
• iCloud sync across all Apple devices
• Clean, minimal design
• No account required

Whether you're jotting down a grocery list, drafting a journal entry, brainstorming ideas, or keeping a daily planner — Scrap is the notepad that stays out of your way.

Download Scrap today and start writing.
